title: Site config
description: The site config file (ADR 0024). Every key is optional; an unknown key is an error.

title.description: Site name for the header, page titles, llms.txt, and JSON-LD. Default: the folder name.

description.description: One-sentence summary of the site, for the home page's meta description and llms.txt.

url.description: Scheme and host of the published site, without a trailing slash, such as https://example.github.io. Without it canonical links, the sitemap, and social images are relative or left out, with a warning.

base.description: Path the site lives under, starting with / and without a trailing slash; empty at a domain root. Every URL the engine writes carries it.

lang.description: Default language of every page, as a BCP 47 tag. A page's lang wins.

dir.description: Default text direction. Unset, it comes from lang (rtl for fa, ar, he, ur, and the other right-to-left languages). A page's dir wins.

languages.description: The site's languages in switcher order. Leave it out for a one-language site.

source.description: Folder that holds the content, relative to the site root. Files outside it are not pages.

include.description: Paths under source that discovery would skip (names starting with . or _) but should be copied or built, such as .well-known.

exclude.description: Paths under source that are neither pages nor copied. node_modules, the output folder, and the config file are always excluded.

navigation.description: Navigation file, relative to the site root. When it does not exist, navigation is built from folders and each page's order.

defaults.description: Front matter applied to every page under a path unless the page sets the key itself. Later entries win over earlier ones; a page always wins.

url.description: The repository's web URL, such as https://github.com/example/example.

branch.description: Branch that edit links point to.

dir.description: The site root's folder inside the repository, such as docs.

repository.description: Where the source lives, for Edit this page links and the Edit with your agent prompt.

name.description: Theme package or folder. Default: the theme that ships with the engine.

options.description: Handed to the theme unread; the theme validates it against its own schema.

theme.description: The theme that builds the site and the options handed to it.

text.description: The most characters of a page's body the index keeps. Titles and headings are always indexed.

search.description: false builds no search index. As an object, text sets how much of each page's body the index keeps.

redirects.description: Redirect pages: each key is an old path under base, each value a path on the site or an https URL.

outputs.description: Turns an output off by its name (false), such as twins or llms. The loader checks the names against the output registry; an unknown name is an error.

name.description: Name shown in the language switcher, in that language.

prefix.description: URL prefix of this language's pages, such as /fa; empty for the default language.

path.description: Folder relative to source; empty for every page.

values.description: Front matter keys and values to apply.
